item.title: Vaultwarden hiding Email 2FA behind a Cloudflare tunnel
item.description:
I run a Vaultwarden instance that can be reached through two hostnames: one goes through a Cloudflare tunnel, the other through a router port forward straight to Envoy Gateway. After configuring SMTP so that users could enable two-step login by email, the Email option appeared in the web vault’s two-step login settings (/#/settings/security/two-factor) on the second hostname, but not on the first.

The problem

Both hostnames lead to the same pod, so the difference had to come from what sits in front of it. The API returned the same server configuration either way:
